profile.headline: Software Engineer at McDonald's
profile.summary:
Lloyd Smith is a Software Engineer with a strong interest in technology, art, psychology, astronomy, physics, statistics, business, and science. He is proficient in using detailed computer applications, coding languages, and frameworks.

GitHub: 
https://www.github.com/LSmith1122

Android Engineering
•	Android Studio
•	Android SDK
•	Kotlin
•	Java
•	Retrofit
•	RxJava/RxKotlin
•	SQL/SQLite 3
•	Gradle & Maven
•	Jetpack Compose
•	Coroutines
•	Hilt/Dagger
•	and more… 

Java Web Development
•	Java/Kotlin
•	IntelliJ IDE
•	Back-end Servers & Microservices
•	Spring/Spring Boot
•	Eureka
•	Swagger
•	HTML
•	CSS
•	Bootstrap
•	JavaScript
•	Redis
•	Hibernate
•	AWS - S3
•	ReactJS (in development as of this writing Feb 2024)
•	and more… 

CI/CD, Environment Tools, etc.
•	Git
•	GitHub
•	SourceTree
•	Jenkins
•	Sonar/SonarQube
•	Splunk
•	and more…

Miscellaneous
•	Adobe CC Applications
•	Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.)
•	Computer Aided Design and Blueprint Drafting
•	and more… 

(See complete list of Skills in profile)

Lloyd is currently focusing on sharpening previously acquired skills to be well-versed and more valuable in various roles (including Android, Software and Web Development, etc.) and obtaining skills in areas to explore new sectors (Algorithms, Physics, Probability, ML, AI, etc.).

Lloyd is a firm advocate of helping and growing with others while practicing dynamic and flexible learning techniques. Upon acquiring a broad range of skill sets through traditional teachings and unconventionally self-taught methods, he has been actively exploring various techniques to help others learn more efficiently. With this passion and experience, Lloyd aims to help solve seemingly complicated issues, improve our current practices, and make contributions to the efforts of progression in - and the advancement of - human life for all.

positions.title: Portrait Photographer
positions.description:
Conducts consultations with clients and representatives.
Works with all aspects of digital photography and lighting.
Travels to site or book time slots for studio use, if necessary.
Sets up multiple cameras for different shooting situations.
Handles multiple projects/sessions simultaneously.
Manages the completion of project tasks.
Ensures assignments are completed on schedule.
Engages excellent customer service skills towards subjects to gain natural smile in photos.
Adjusts subject positioning and resolve any conflict resolution as necessary for photographs.
Culls, edits and retouches images to best match style of creative direction
Setup and break down photo stations.

positions.description: Software Developer working at Bosch Engineering - contracted through Modis - currently with a focus on Android and Java Development for automobile service and diagnostic systems.

positions.title: Mobile Software Developer
positions.description: Software Developer working at Bosch Engineering - contracted through TEKsystems - currently with a focus on Android and Java Development for automobile service and diagnostic systems.

positions.title: Mobile Software Developer Intern
positions.description:
My Appraisals Android and Web application allow Appraisers the ability to accept new appraisals, send/receive status updates and messages for appraisal appointments, view/update availability, and more.

•	Developed production release code (in C# for the web application and Java and Kotlin for the Android application) and its custom modular libraries
•	Adhered to modern clean coding guidelines (SOLID, DRY) 
•	Pair-programmed with other developers in an Agile Scrum team 
•	Collaborated with outside teams to coordinate join programming efforts
•	Regularly worked with software development platforms such as Git, GitHub, SourceTree, SonarQube, Jenkins, TFS, Microsoft Visual Studio, Microsoft SQL Server, Swagger, etc.

positions.title: Mobile Software Developer Intern
positions.description:
My Signings application for Android devices allows Signing Agents to accept new closing appointments and update the status of closing appointments

•	Regularly worked with software development platforms such as Git, GitHub, SourceTree, SonarQube, and Jenkins
